changelog:
- Major update: skill now generates a complete, structured GTM asset pack covering positioning, messaging, features/benefits, and role-specific use cases.
- Adopts Geoffrey Moore's positioning framework for sharp, competitor-differentiated statements.
- Messaging pillars require 2–3 specific proof points per pillar (with flagged assumptions if data is missing).
- Feature list must map every capability to a clear buyer benefit; no feature-only entries allowed.
- Use cases must include a before/after structure tied to real buyer roles.
- Adds detailed scoring rubric and checklist for consistent, launch-ready output; removes previous playbook and checklist style.
- skill-card.md file removed; documentation and scope are now consolidated in SKILL.md.
summary: Create go-to-market assets for any product or feature. Use when asked for a GTM plan, positioning statement, product launch plan, messaging pillars, use case...
